definition: `IsSupremelyGood`: g is good in respect of being (ST I q.5 a.1, goodness is actuality) and causes every perfection of every other being (ST I q.6 a.2, all desired perfections flow from it as from their first cause).
note: Combines q.5 a.1 and q.6 a.2 into one predicate; neither article states the conjunction as a definition. Goodness in respect of being is DEF-GOOD-AS-BEING-IN-ACT; causing every perfection is DEF-CAUSE-OF-PERFECTION.
